chunks: And Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl ibn Bazīʿ narrated; he said:
I sent dirhams to Abū al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā عليه السلام on behalf of myself and others, and I wrote to him informing him that they were from the fiṭrah of the dependents.
So he عليه السلام wrote in his own handwriting: “I have received it.”

key_terms.فِطْرَةِ: fiṭrah; the alms of breaking the fast, Zakat al-Fiṭrah

ai.seo_question: Can Zakat al-Fiṭrah be sent to Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام or his representative on behalf of one’s dependents?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl ibn Bazīʿ sent dirhams to Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام as fiṭrah on behalf of himself and others in his household. The Imam’s written reply, stating that he had received it, indicates acceptance of the payment and relates to the practice of discharging Zakat al-Fiṭrah through the Imam عليه السلام.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2083 - It is narrated by Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Bazi', who said:
"I sent some dirhams to Abu Al-Hasan Al-Ridha (as) on behalf of myself and others, and I wrote to him informing him that it was for the Zakat al-Fitr of the dependents.
Imam (as) wrote back in his own handwriting: 'I have received it.'"
